build_task_scene: build a PHYRE task scene with static bars, a dynamic ball, and target beams using the creator API
create_static_obstacles: create static bar obstacles positioned at specific heights and horizontal locations in the scene
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene centered at a given position with a specified scale
define_task_success: define task success criteria by setting body1, body2, and a TOUCHING spatial relationship
register_task_with_decorator: register a new PHYRE task using the define_task decorator from the creator library
